ticker_news.title: Global Portfolio Returns May Be Entering a Lower-Growth Phase
ticker_news.description: The Global Market Index (GMI) forecasts a moderate decline in long-term investment returns, with an expected annualized return of 7.3%, which is below its 10-year performance of 8.2%. US equities are expected to be the primary underperforming asset class.
ticker_news.author: James Picerno
